# Sample a curve with named parameters

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With a=2,b=1 and t=\[0,1,2\], \[a*t,b+t\] gives x=\[0,2,4\],y=\[1,2,3\]. The parameter Array contains genuine named Cluster values.

## What this example demonstrates

With a=2,b=1 and t=\[0,1,2\], \[a*t,b+t\] gives x=\[0,2,4\],y=\[1,2,3\]. The parameter Array contains genuine named Cluster values.
